title: Greg Young — A Decade of DDD, CQRS, Event Sourcing
summary: Greg Young, who coined CQRS, looks back on a decade of domain-driven design, CQRS and event sourcing at DDD Europe 2016. He discusses where event sourcing applies and how simple its core can be.
why: HN commenters cite it in event sourcing threads for Young's views on when to use it, including advice against cross-application event sourcing.

quote.text: Greg Young reduces the "framework" to a function, a pattern match & a left fold.
